allot.subject: Press Release
allot.text: GACM Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 21, 2026, titled "Successfully Completion of Qualified Institutions Placement by the Company".

allot.subject: Allotment of Securities
allot.text: GACM Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange regarding allotment of 495000000 securities pursuant to Qualified Institution Placement at its meeting held on August 17, 2026

allot.subject: Updates
allot.text: GACM Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Outcome of RICM for Basis of Allotment'.

allot.subject: Revised Record date
allot.text: GACM Technologies Limited had intimated the 26-Apr-2025 as the record date. The Company has now informed the Exchange that the Record date has been revised to 28-Apr-2025 for the purpose of Rights Issue.

allot.subject: General Updates
allot.text: GACM Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange about Outcome of rights issue committee

allot.subject: Updates
allot.text: GACM Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Corrigendum to Notice of Preferential Issue Committee'.

allot.subject: Updates
allot.text: GACM Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Prior Intimation of Notice of Preferential Issue Committee '.
